_doc: Copy to configs/detector_class_map.json and fill in one entry per class of YOUR detector model.
index = the class id the YOLOv8 model outputs; card = our card id (configs/card_costs_hf.json keys) or null to ignore.
side: 1 = opponent, 0 = you, null = decide from the health-bar colour above the box (side_mode 'color').
Ignore (card: null) towers, effects, and units that are SPAWNED rather than played (e.g. goblins from a Goblin Hut), or they will be counted as plays.
